entry.title: Zork Grand Inquisitor v3.0.0
entry.content: This is a major feature release that also includes improvements, tweaks and fixes. **This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.** - **Feature:** 43 new locations. Item pickups (+41). Misc (+2) - **Feature:** 2 new areas. Flathead Mesa (+4). Outside the Monastery Exhibit (+1). Flathead Mesa is accessed by casting VOXAM in the Walking Castle - **Feature:** 12 new Deathsanity / Landmarksanity locations. Deaths (+9). Landmarks (+3) - **Feature:** Shuffle Time Tunnels option. Randomizes the destinations of the three time tunnels - **Feature:** Death return. After dying, you're sent back to the previous screen, as it was, and you can keep playing. No need to juggle saves - **Feature:** In-Game Overlay option. Shows goal progress, item notifications, traps, death links and optionally the locations in logic. Can be toggled while playing with `/overlay` and `/overlay_tracker` - **Feature:** Universal Tracker integration. UT's tabs are now part of the client, and the `?` buttons explaining how to check each location have been moved to UT's Tracker Page - **Improvement:** The client now hooks directly into ZVision and as a result is lighter and more responsive. No more jank, glitches or crash risks from memory writes - **Improvement:** Entrance randomizer transitions now go straight to their destination - **Improvement:** Received items are now recorded in your save - **Improvement:** Trap management reworked. Reverse Controls and ZVision traps can be active at the same time - **Improvement:** Optional granting of missable locations reworked. Missables are granted as soon as they become unobtainable while in logic. Now works with ER. Requires UT - **Tweak:** The client's Tracker tab is now the Items tab, without a location list. The Entrances tab now only appears when playing with ER - **Tweak:** The bottom of the well can now be exited by casting VOXAM - **Tweak:** Activating the Zork Rocks now starts the 10-second countdown right away - **Tweak:** The ZVision trap now uses a fisheye view instead of scrambling the screen - **Fix:** Addressed a vanilla totemizer crash due to a missing audio file - **Fix:** Goal completion is no longer sent to the server repeatedly - **Fix:** _I Spit on Your Filthy Coinage_, _That's Still a Rope_ and _Your Puny Weapons Don't Phase Me, Baby!_ no longer trigger without fully performing the action - **Fix:** Addressed an issue where _Make Love, Not War_, _Death: Old Age_ and _Death: Expressly Forbidden_ were only in logic from one side - **Fix:** VOXAM can no longer remain in a stuck state - **Fix:** Removed items can no longer briefly reappear in the inventory - **Fix:** Addressed a rare issue where scroll fragments could end up incorrectly mirrored - **Fix:** Leaving Hades through ER or VOXAM now always correctly clears active SNAVIG casts - **Fix:** The Port Foozle propaganda lines no longer follow you to other starting locations - **Fix:** The Old Scratch card death now has its own death link message - **Fix:** Addressed an issue where connecting would fail when running the client with `--nogui` _YAML changes:_ - _New options: Shuffle Time Tunnels and In-Game Overlay_ - _Artifacts of Magic Total and Required now go up to 20 (defaults are now 20 and 15)_ - _Deaths Required now goes up to 31 and Landmarks Required up to 23_ - _Starting Location now defaults to random_ A new version of ScummVM is required. Follow the updated [setup guide](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/zgi-v2-post-removal/worlds/zork_grand_inquisitor/docs/setup_en.md)

entry.title: Half-Life (Sven Co-op) v0.4.0
entry.content:
Sven Co-op's Half-Life campaign is meant to be played in multiplayer. No support will be offered to players attempting to circumvent this restriction. (The map "Suspension" is an exception to this rule)
**Important**: Run /install to update the plugin after you update your apworld.
## New Features * !menu GUI added * Melee Throw can now be added to the item pool, allowing you to throw the crowbar, knife, and umbrella via right click. * Bot Swarm Trap * Bots will use any player models the server host has available * PCV and Security Armor are now randomized separate from the HEV suit * Flashlight can now be randomized * Xen Healing pools added to chargesanity * Shock roach now accounted for in OpFor * Item receipt notifications show in chat
## Bug Fixes/Improvements * Fixed an edge case crash related to pre-cacheing * Fixed access to various location * Locations not present in a seed no longer display in game * When LJM is unshuffled, it now sits at its vanilla location rather than being always active * Gate access to some checks behind the displacement cannon and other weapons * Only one mission given to start across all campaigns * Major weapon logic overhaul * The first occurence of each weapon in each mission it appears can be a valid "First (Weapon)" check logically * Some inaccessible checks removed: old seeds will grant them on entering the map they were on * Changed location prefix to use colons instead of dashes * Goal no longer sent on the final mission's location being collected by the server. You have to physically play through it still. * Restarting the client no longer re-delivers all of the filler and trap items * Various stability and parity patches to match the HL Trilogy apworld
## Updates to commands: (use `!help` to list all): * `!menu` provides a helpful GUI for various tracking and warp commands * `!find` is now further refined to punish height more so that the nearest check is more frequently the closest accessible check. * `!tracker` now filters better
## Setup As the game host: Install the apworld by downloading and double clicking (or placing it in your custom_worlds folder) Open the Half-Life (Sven Co-op) Client and select your install directory Run /install in the client Connect the client to the multiworld, and open a server on the map -sp_campaign_lobby Once your friends are in game with you (they can just join!), you can type !ap to see unlocked missions in the console, and !warp to change maps to the unlocked mission. (The lobby's mission panels also work). In addition, !menu opens an interface to warp, return to hub, find the nearest check, track remaining checks in a map, or locate a specific check.
## Known Issues * Sound cacheing bug: sometimes when another player joins the lobby, their sounds are all mixed up. This will self resolve once you get into a mission. I am under the impression that if they install the plugin too that helps, but either way, loading a new map should fix the issue.
Note: This apworld is fully backwards compatible with previous versions

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.3
entry.content:
CTR Archipelago 0.2.3 is out. Here's the quick list; the [full release notes are on AP-Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/releases/0-2-3).
[Setup guide (ap-pie.com)](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr) · [SETUP.md](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/main/SETUP.md) · [SETUP.md as shipped](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/v0.2.3/SETUP.md)
## What changed since 0.2.2
- **DeathLink rework:** a received death applies only in a live race and is never saved for later. A death that arrives during a pause lands when the race runs again. Every received death shows a popup. - **DeathLink crash:** fixed the crash when a DeathLink arrived with `death_link: race_loss`. - **DeathLink Send:** new YAML option `death_link_send` (`mask_grab`, `weapon_hit`, `race_loss`) chooses what sends a death. Old YAMLs behave as before. There is no send-only DeathLink. - **Race loss goes both ways:** losing a race, a Gem Cup, or restarting or exiting to the map from the pause menu sends a death. - **In game:** three new rows on Options > Archipelago: DL SEND FALL, DL SEND HIT, DL SEND LOSS. - **Relic Race:** the pad no longer closes before you can take the Perfect check, and it shows the item placed there. - **Frame rate:** fixed the low frame rate in the hubs, especially Gem Stone Valley ([#376](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/376)). - **Warp pads:** the glow shows the item of every open location, boxes, letters and Wumpa included. - **Letters:** short names in the item feed for Slide Coliseum, Turbo Track and Cortex Vortex. - **Tracker:** boss garage nodes are gold, green or red by garage state. - **Logic (Progressive Boost on):** every Relic Race Perfect needs Ultimate Sacred Fire, Held 1st has no boost floor on hard, and trial-track Gold and Platinum relics are gated like the other tracks.
## Downloads
Get `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.3-windows-x86.zip` for Windows or `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.3-linux-x86.tar.gz` for Linux and Steam Deck (glibc 2.36 or newer). Each has the client and the matching `ctr.apworld`. A 0.2.2 room can be played on the 0.2.3 client; for new seeds use the 0.2.3 client and APWorld together. Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer is needed to host. The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are for hosts and generators. The `.sha256` files check your downloads, `manifest.json` and `manifest.json.minisig` are the signed manifest (how to check it is in the full notes), and the `.debug` files help with crash reports; you don't need them to play. You need your own NTSC-U disc; no game data is included. The client isn't code-signed.
Known issues: short pauses on screen changes, large reconnect backlogs can stall the game ([#147](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/147)), and some podium characters can show up invisible ([#282](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/282)). Not run on the Steam Deck.
## Download checksums
| Asset | SHA-256 | |---|---| | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.3-windows-x86.zip` | `1c5d6c74940844379ed80f84c40c5f2b2c4bc4563ff95d0a3c4f57bfdcb6c407` | | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.3-linux-x86.tar.gz` | `fb4db136a43a4c1d68347b736cee57b3c3c271f9bc09f4864a1483edb45a4076` | | `ctr.apworld` | `726deb6df971ecd843f42b96508ef2e36b44c4c62167e1f3648e4b4f02b94acb` | | `manifest.json` | `4d30fd9d5625c8f13f55000b6913e67af5f79e973e2065fb9fc202a238fad98e` |
## Reporting a problem
[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) with your client version, platform, seed or YAML and what happened. Include the support bundle when it helps: run `support-bundle.bat` on Windows or `support-bundle.sh` on Linux and check it before attaching; it doesn't upload anything by itself. Questions are welcome in the [Crash Team Racing channel](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1222304293751750777) on the Archipelago Discord.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.17.4
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **Bot cards: named defender bots you unlock during the run.** Turn on **Unlockable Bot Cards** and the item pool holds cards for 15 bots. Each bot has a class, a loadout and a buff of its own. A card rolls a rarity, which sets its health and buff stacks, and a form: human, robot or Giant robot. **Starting Bot Cards** gives some at the start, or one stock card per class. Cards are useful items and never lock a mission. Off by default. By kelly-cs. - **The Bots page shows your cards as a deck.** Recruit cards into your six seats, drag them to set who stays when a player joins, and choose the form. **Apply** swaps the bots on the running server, with no restart. The tracker shows the cards the run has found. In test mode every card is there. - **Shop where they stand**, a Bots page option. Every bot buys its upgrades where it is instead of walking back to the station. A bot that shops during a wave stays in the fight. Off by default. A Giant card always shops where it stands, because it no longer fits through the spawn door. ### Fixed - **A tank SigMod keeps off the network no longer breaks Mental.** On some community missions Mental threw an error for such a tank every tick, tens of thousands a run. - **Make it Count works on a Windows server.** It switched itself off there, because the plugin could not find the dispenser's ammo function on Windows. - **A server whose bridge stops answering no longer runs out of memory.** The plugin sent every check it was still holding again every five seconds, so each giant and tank killed while the bridge was down made the traffic grow, until the server stopped with "Out of memory" a few missions later. It now retries the oldest check alone until the bridge answers, then sends the rest. - **Bots are no longer put back on the hatch over and over.** The rescue for a bot that is slow to leave spawn puts it on the hatch. On most maps the hatch sits next to RED's spawn, so a few seconds later the rescue moved it again. An engineer that built near the hatch lost its nest before it finished. - **Weapon buffs no longer climb on their own.** The server counted the same grants again each time it asked the bridge. A buff you had twice then showed as x44 in the weapon buffs menu until the next mission. By kelly-cs. - **Repair fixes a community pack that fails its hash check.** Repair left the old download in place, so the next install stopped on the same "SHA-256 mismatch". It now downloads the pack again and keeps the old file until the new one checks out. A mismatch you chose to ignore is left alone. By kelly-cs. - **Repair on Windows also throws away the downloaded SigMod package.** It only ever looked for the Linux file, so a broken download stayed in place. - **Every SigMod mission plays to the end on a Windows server.** The Windows build of SigMod is updated, and all 95 community missions that need it now play every wave, where about ten used to stop the server mid-mission. Robots that change attributes, map-scripted events, bosses with several phases, bots' dropped items and swords all behave as they do on a Linux server. A squad with a gray robot in it no longer stalls its wave (Dust to Dust, wave 5). Linux and Docker servers keep the regular SigMod release. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * Honor the selected wave when playing or replaying a mission by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/141 * Label Villa missions as Medic only by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/144 * Prevent Cow Mangler bonus shots colliding with shooter by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/145 * Link admin tracker and clarify per-class loadout order by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/148 * Handle Villa defender orders and final boss transfer by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/142 * Preserve explosive-jump force with no-self-blast buff by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/146 * feat(waveprobe): a Windows bed for the SigMod missions by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/166 * chore(deps): tf2-mvm-bots-go v0.18.1 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/169 * feat(waveprobe): measure how the defender bots move by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/149 * Prevent replayed weapon buffs from increasing levels by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/168 * Repair redownloads community packs after a hash mismatch by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/151 * chore(deps): tf2-mvm-bots-go v0.18.2 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/170 * docs(changelog): bot cards, shop where they stand, and Kelly's two fixes by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/171 * SigMod for Windows 20260930, and the wave probe plays every SigMod mission to the end by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/172 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.17.3...v1.17.4 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZGM3NGQzMWEwN2U4OWI0NmI3MmE2NGIzZjM3ZjVhOWE6MTc5MDgwMzQwNw==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YjhiNjBhYTNmMDUyZmE4N2NmNWM0NzY2ZTE1OTI1N2E6MTc5MDgwMzQxMA==/detection)

entry.title: Pokemon Crystal v6.0.0
entry.content:
# Pokémon Crystal 6.0.0 - The EX(C)ITING Update
# Changelog
## Entrance Randomization - **Randomize Entrances**: Entrances can now be randomized! Choose which categories of entrance are shuffled: Dungeon, Dungeon Interior, Gym, Gym Interior, Mart, Mart Interior, Building, Building Interior, Gate, Pokécenter, Elevator, Pokémon League and One-Way. - **Mix Entrances**: Sets which categories shuffle together in a single pool, any category left out will only shuffle among itself. - **Coupled Entrances**: Entrances can be coupled, where going back through an entrance takes you back where you came from, or decoupled, where every entrance is randomized independently. - **Plando Connections**: Force specific entrance pairings, or pin entrances to their vanilla destinations. - Elevators are fully supported, each floor is its own entrance. - NPCs blocking a warp you arrive through will now step out of the way, and scripted scenes account for being entered from unexpected directions. - Entrances have friendly names in the spoiler log and hints. - Entrance information is included in hint data (thanks @snowflav-goob). - Support for Universal Tracker deferred entrances.
## New Goals - **Battle Tower**: Beat all 10 Battle Tower tiers. - **Multigoal**: Goal now accepts a list of goals, all selected goals must be completed to win. - Talking to or calling Prof. Elm will tell you all of your goals (thanks @snowflav-goob).
## New Areas - **Flooded Mine**: Adds a new small cave connecting Cherrygrove City and Route 32, with new wild encounters, three hidden items and a TM. - **Route 23 Restored**: Inserts a restored Route 23 between Victory Road and Victory Road Gate, with new wild encounters, grass, a berry tree and two hidden items (thanks @BunkBunker).
## New Locations - **Battle Tower Sanity**: Adds a location for clearing each Battle Tower tier, and optionally each individual Battle Tower trainer. Your team is levelled down to match the tier, items can't be used from the bag, held items must all be different and the trainers use the best possible AI. Pokémon with 600 or more BST require the Uber Pass, which is shuffled into the item pool. - **Battle Tower Progressive Tier Unlocks**: Locks Battle Tower tiers behind progressive unlock items. - **Rematchsanity**: Phone trainer rematches are now checks. Rematches unlock in order as you hit story milestones and require the Pokégear and Phone Card. - **Momsanity**: Adds 10 locations for the items Mom buys you while saving your money. Items that go in your bag are deposited in the PC, others go in the new BANK OF MOM collection box in the PC. - **Randomize Lucky Number Show**: Adds the three Lucky Number Show prizes as locations, the winning IDs are taken from the Pokémon received in three random in-game trades. - Sage Li at the top of Sprout Tower is now a Trainersanity check. - The East-West Underground now has hidden items (thanks @BunkBunker).
## Fly Changes - **Randomize Fly Destinations**: Randomizes where each flypoint takes you, with a blocklist and plando (huge thanks @snowflav-goob for this one). - Indigo Plateau is now included in Fly Unlock randomization and Free Fly. - The Fly Cheese option has been removed, vanilla Fly unlocks are always considered in logic.
## Time of Day - **Time of Day Encounters**: Land encounters vary by morning/day/night and fishing encounters vary by day/night, each time period is randomized independently. - **Unlockable Time of Day**: You must find the Morn, Day and Nite items to access encounters for those time periods, you start with one at random. - Time of day can now be switched from the Pokégear. - The AREA page of the Pokédex now shows encounters split by time of day.
## New Logic Options - **Victory Road Requirement/Count**: Sets the requirement to pass the Victory Road badge check. The Elite Four Requirement/Count options now control going between the Indigo Plateau Pokécenter and Will's room. - **Route 22 Access Requirement/Count**: Replaces Kanto Access Requirement/Count. - **Lance Requires Elite Four**: Lance's room kicks you out unless you've beaten all four Elite Four members. - **Vanilla Event Chains**: Restores vanilla event chains for Misty, Clair, Jasmine and the Copycat. This replaces Vanilla Clair. - **South Kanto Access**: New option `both`, which places landslides on both Route 19 and Route 21. - **Route 12 Access**: New option `weird_tree_surf_block`, which adds boulders to prevent surfing around the Weird Tree (thanks @snowflav-goob). - **Pokémon Request Logic**: Restricts which encounter sources may provide Pokémon for randomized requests and trades. - **Dexsanity Logic**: Restricts which encounter sources may provide Pokémon for Dexsanity and Dexcountsanity. - Swarms can now be required by logic in Wild Encounter Methods Required, they require Randomize Phone Calls.
## Pokémon Randomization - **Wild Match Mode**: Wild Pokémon can now be matched by type, base stat total, or both. - Static Pokémon and trainer parties can now be matched by base stat total, or by both type and base stat total. - **Unique Static Pokémon**: Makes static encounter species unique, excluding them from other statics and the wild. Can apply to legendaries only, legendaries and unique overworld encounters, or all statics. - **Shared Wild Encounters**: Players who enable this share identical wild encounters, generated from the multiworld seed. - **Base Stats Evolution Mode**: Allows evolutions to inherit their pre-evolution's stat spread so evolving always increases BST. - **Force Fully Evolved**: New `evolution_level` option, which evolves each opponent Pokémon into what it would naturally be at its level. - **Growth Rates**: Normalizes growth rates so legendaries use Slow and all other Pokémon use Medium Fast. This is on by default. - **TM/HM Compatibility**: Split into same type and other type compatibility for both TMs and HMs. - **Modify Palettes**: Replaces Randomize Palettes, adds Swap Shiny (regular Pokémon use shiny palettes and vice versa) and Gold and Silver (restores palettes that changed in Crystal) (thanks @snowflav-goob). - Randomized traded Pokémon now respect the Static Blocklist. - The Wild Encounter Blocklist now applies to the bug catching contest. - Randomized trainer movesets now favour moves from the Pokémon's learnset over TM/HM moves. - **Move Modernisation**: The Pokémon Champions move changes are now included as Generation 9 changes, and `newest` can be used to modernise to the latest generation (thanks @jespoketheepic). - **Randomize Moves**: New `_RandomExcludingAccuracy` option.
## Evolution Items - Evolution stones are now reusable key items. - Trade evolutions now use the new Link Cable key item instead of evolving at level 37. Pokémon which evolve by trading with a held item (King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Up-Grade) must be holding it when the Link Cable is used. - Held evolution items can't be tossed and are returned to your bag if their holder leaves your party permanently. - Evolution items are now progression items that are in the item pool, they are downgraded to useful if they aren't required for progression.
## Co-op - **Wonder Trading**: Trade Pokémon with other players in your multiworld, including other Pokémon games, by speaking to the receptionist on the second floor of any Pokécenter. - **EnergyLink**: Deposit and withdraw money from the BANK OF AP in the PC. - More events are now synced between players on the same slot when Remote Items is enabled: - The Route 30 battle, getting the Mystery Egg and talking to Mom after the Mystery Egg quest. - Meeting Kurt, the Rocket blocking Azalea Gym and herding Farfetch'd. - Kurt returning the GS Ball. - Beating your rival in Mt. Moon. - Healing Moomoo. - Jasmine explaining Amphy's sickness. - Rocket Hideout passwords. - Agreeing to help Lance. - Using the Card Key in the Radio Tower. - Finding the girl on the Fast Ship. - Showing Pokémon to Bill's Grandpa. - Visiting Goldenrod, Olivine, Ecruteak, Mahogany, Lake of Rage, Cianwood and Blackthorn (these gate rematches). - Beating the Elite Four, and the Elite Four doors. - Clearing the landslide in south Kanto. - The Misty event chain. - Goal progress. - Fly unlocks are now synced directly between slots instead of being Plando'd to their original locations.
## New Traps - **Shuffle Trap**: Randomizes the order of items in your Items and Balls pockets. - Phone traps and DeathLinks can now trigger while standing still.
## Quality of Life - **Move Reminder**: A Move Reminder can be found on the second floor of every Pokécenter. - **Fast Bike**: Hold B (or not, with Auto Run on) while cycling to go even faster. - **Fast Surf** now works like running. - **Battle Always Run**: An in-game option to always escape wild battles, including through trapping moves. - **Scaling EXP**: An in-game option to scale EXP by level difference, as in Generation 5. - **Music**: An in-game option to turn music on or off. - **Item Popups**: Items received from other players can now be shown in a popup at the top of the screen. - **Exp Share Type**: Choose between the vanilla Exp Share or the toggleable Exp All key item. - **Colored Item Balls**: Overworld item balls can now be tinted by the classification of the item they hold. - **Trainer Gender**, **Rival Name** and **Start Time**: Preset these to skip the prompts at the start of the game (thanks @snowflav-goob). - **Trainer Palette**: Can now be a custom hex colour. - **Item Value Plando**: Set the base value of individual items. - Items can now be received during battle. - GO HOME has been moved to the Start menu. - Rare Candies and vitamins can now be used multiple times at once. - Levelling up multiple levels at once now skips the intermediate levels. - Teleport can now be used anywhere. - Trades now show both the requested and offered Pokémon at the same time. - Move type and category display in battle is now consistent. - Hidden Power now displays its actual type and power. - Fast egg hatch now applies immediately to all eggs. - Speedy battle animations now also skip cries when depositing or withdrawing in the PC. - The credits can now always be fast-forwarded. - Hold to Mash now also hangs up Pokégear phone calls. - Build-a-Mart can now stock evolution items, the Link Cable, and the Master, Friend, Fast, Heavy, Level, Love, Lure and Moon Balls. - Shop hints can now be sent when leaving a shop, and marts now show the classification of remote items. - The client now warns you when your bag is full. - Blackbelt Kiyo's Tyrogue is now sent to the PC if your party is full. - Prof. Elm now tells you to show him the hatched Pokémon for the Everstone. - Running now tolerates a dropped input frame when turning corners. - Speedy battle animations now skip the wait when sending out a Pokémon. - The Balls pocket now holds 20 items instead of 16. - Bill now calls you if your box is full after the Bug Catching Contest.
## Other Option Changes - New option groups for Johto Roadblocks, Kanto Roadblocks, Battle Tower and Intro Presets. - The Ilex Forest Cut tree is no longer removed by default. - The old individual trap weight options and `randomize_move_types` are no longer accepted, use `trap_weights` and `randomize_moves` instead. - `all_pokemon_seen` and `encounter_slot_distribution` can now be overridden at patch time. - Early Fly now guarantees a Pokémon that can learn Fly is available in sphere 1. - The TM Blocklist no longer accepts HMs, Headbutt or Rock Smash. - Patch files no longer include the basepatch, making them much smaller. - Patching now checks that your APWorld version is compatible (thanks @snowflav-goob).
## Bug Fixes - Fix logic swapping the Mineral and Storm badges when badges are vanilla. - Fix the Farfetch'd herding event logically requiring Cut. - Fix the Route 19 careful swimming sign logically requiring Surf. - Fix the Route 41 hidden Max Ether being in logic without Whirlpool. - Fix Route 27 West headbutt trees being in logic without Surf. - Fix Route 26 headbutt trees not being in logic. - Fix the Lavender Radio Tower EXPN Card location not requiring power to be restored when Remote Items was on and the Pokégear wasn't randomized. - Fix Universal Tracker showing Celebi as reachable without Flash when Ilex Forest requires Flash. - Fix wild level scaling considering surfing encounters reachable without Surf. - Fix Pokémon which overflowed the logical wild pool not being placed correctly. - Fix TM/HM same type compatibility using the vanilla TM moves instead of the randomized ones. - Fix HM Compatibility Override not applying if all other compatibility was vanilla. - Fix trades set to vanilla or received still randomizing some requested Pokémon. - Fix shop items belonging to other players being given minimum prices based on your own item values. - Fix shop prices not being deterministic for the same seed and settings. - Fix start inventory silently losing items when it didn't fit, generation will now fail instead. Blue Card points are now capped at 99. - Fix Tyrogue not being able to reach all its evolutions with randomized base stats. - Fix Hidden Power ignoring the randomized physical/special split and move modernisation. - Fix battles awarding more than 65535 EXP granting very small amounts of EXP. - Fix Gen 2 EXP division counting empty party slots. - Fix non-participants getting no EXP from the Exp Share when all participants were level 100. - Fix the Pokécenter 2F battle giving a level 100 Pokémon if your lead Pokémon was level 1. - Fix brief graphical corruption in trainer battles when an enemy Pokémon faints with fast battles. - Fix the wrong sound sometimes playing when receiving a Trainersanity item. - Fix Blackbelt Kiyo not being greyed out by Trainersanity Indication. - Fix Sage Koji skipping the Trainersanity item notification if you'd already been in Tin Tower. - Fix phone trainers holding a gift because your bag was full not giving it to you when you next talk to them. - Fix not being able to wake Snorlax from the north. - Fix the Day Care Pokémon spawning on top of the Route 34 hidden item. - Fix collecting the Potion from Elm's aide sometimes preventing the Officer scene. - Fix being able to move between the auto Flash and wall opening scene in the Ruins of Alph. - Fix Game Corner prize Pokémon showing Pokédex registration if you don't have the Pokédex. - Fix various music randomization issues, including radio tracks being used as map music. - Fix bike and surf music defaulting to off if not provided in the game options. - Fix checks made while disconnected not being sent after reconnecting. - Fix seen Pokémon and Unown sign data storage keys sometimes being overwritten. - Fix region names being cut off in remote item phone calls. - Fix TMs and HMs not playing the TM/HM sound when received. - Fix the Item Pool Fill weights not being applied, every item group was equally likely (thanks @ljtpetersen). - Fix malformed Trap Link messages causing errors in the client, they are now ignored with a warning. - Fix the `/headbutt` and `/fishing` client commands listing some groups that don't apply to your settings (thanks @snowflav-goob). - Fix not being able to run from the Pokécenter 2F battle. - Fix overworld Explosion traps not clearing the status of fainted Pokémon. - Fix the Bug Catching Contest ignoring More Uncaught Encounters. - Fix the Progressive Rod having no item description. - Fix Beverly's phone call text when she has a Nugget for you. - Fix fruit trees holding another player's item refilling. - Fix Exp Share holders getting too much EXP with Gen 6/8 EXP. - Fix some in-battle traps being dropped. - Fix softlocks when an Ice Trap slides you into a scripted event. - Fix supplying a higher minimum than maximum level curve level not swapping the two values
## Miscellaneous - New phone traps by @palex00, @BunkBunker, @PainSeer and @f-raZ0R. - Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver and PokéPark have been added to the regions for hint phone traps (thanks @snowflav-goob and @Xilictofel). - Pokémon Red, Blue & Yellow have been added to the regions for hint phone traps. - Added a Kanto location group. - Entei and Raikou now only disappear from Tin Tower 1F once they've been caught or defeated. - Receiving the Odd Egg now marks Ditto as seen in the Pokédex. - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3 - :3

It also no longer relies on color to tell you things. - Reworked DeathLink so deaths no longer queue up.

Primarily that Fields of Mourning wasn't sending locations for each encounter, instead only sending them when you walk through the door. Tartarus was only sending locations when completing a bonus side room. - Fixed players who had things set up incorrectly being permanently locked out of checks. Once the issue is corrected, locations should send as normal. - Overlay now notes who you received items from. - Attempted suppression of some camera takeovers when first entering the Crossroads hub. entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.3.0
entry.content:
### New
- **Map helper (`map_helper`, on by default).** The Dragon Universe map shows everything the current chapter has to offer, so you can find your checks without a guide. Each point has a marker in the world and a coloured dot on the overview map: red for fights, green for talk scenes, and so on. Second-playthrough and level-locked points are shown too, which adds 28 fights as checks. - A saga is split into chapters. A **purple** marker opens the next chapter, a **pink** one the previous; a **white** marker goes to the next saga and a **grey** one back to the last. Each needs X and plays the real scene. - By default the next-chapter and next-saga markers appear once you win the fight that opens them. `map_free_travel` makes them always available. - Turning `map_helper` off also turns Saga locks and Interactsanity off. - A story's ending no longer rolls credits the moment you win its last fight. It waits behind a white marker, so you can finish the rest of the map first. - **Item names on the map (`map_item_labels`).** Hovering over a point shows the Archipelago item waiting there and who it is for, coloured by importance: plum for progression, blue for useful, cyan for filler, salmon for traps. - **Item names in the Skill Shop (`shop_item_labels`).** The shop list shows what each capsule sends, coloured the same way. - **Saga locks (`saga_locks`, on by default).** The Frieza, Cell and Buu sagas each need a `Saga Unlock` item before any character can move on to them. The saga a character starts in is always open. The three items can turn up in any order; a saga needs every unlock up to it. - **Interactsanity (`interactsanity`: off / items / talks / both, default both).** Visiting map points sends checks: 204 pickups and 312 talk scenes. Locations are named by chapter and place, and pickups say what the spot holds in the normal game, for example `Goku DU - Saiyan Saga - Ch.1 - ??? near East City (Dragon Radar)`. - **Fighter unlocks (`fighter_unlocks`, on by default).** The 27 fighters without a Dragon Universe story (Frieza, Cell, Trunks and the rest) are `Fighter` items, locked in every mode until found. - **Extra skills (`extra_skills`, on by default).** Up to 187 more skill capsules join the item pool: the other fighters' skills and Breakthroughs, fusion forms, and the remaining Dragon Universe character skills. - **Experience items.** Filler now alternates between Zenie and Experience (x1000, x2500, x5000). An item goes to the character you are playing when it arrives, or the next one you play. The level-ups come on the next fight you win, with the usual stat choice. - **`/map on|off`** turns the map helper on or off for the session and shows its state.
### Changed
- **`dragonsanity` is now a choice:** `all` (default) keeps every Dragon Ball and each wish as a check, `wishes` keeps only the wishes, `off` neither. `true` and `false` in an old yaml still work. - **Dragon Ball checks count pickups.** The game hands out a random missing ball, so `Dragon Ball: Goku #1` is now the first ball Goku picks up, whichever it is. - **Dragon Arena appears on the main menu as soon as the ticket arrives.** You no longer have to enter and leave Dragon Universe to make it show.

It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. entry.title: Final Fantasy VIII v0.9.0
entry.content:
## What's new in v0.9.0
- **Early Ragnarok no longer opens later-disc towns.** The world map kept a Disc 3 story value for its doors after every fight; the client now restores the real one, so towns open only when your story reaches them. - **Story-jump guard:** if a scene pushes the story several chapters ahead at once, story checks and the goal are held (reload an earlier save, or `/ff8keepstory`). Save loads are now detected reliably. - **Fixes:** Death x5 / Pain x5 gave the wrong spells; a status-attack junction was wiped while Elemental Defense was locked; drawn magic was taken from Squall; Card Club checks fired mid-dialogue; Monsters Felled counted late; the Magical Lamp works with Diablos owned; fast-travel labels and battle Potions. - **Logic (new seeds):** GF ability prerequisite chains, Tonberries need Key: Centra Ruins, Bika Snowfield Flare #2 needs the Ragnarok, no keys in Ultimecia's Castle. - **New options (off by default):** Enemy Power and AP Multiplier (experimental), Triple Triad Rules (no Random / Open), Triple Triad Rule Checks. - **Tracker 0.15.0:** a toggle per junction and command lock.
v0.8.0 seeds keep working with this client; the logic fixes need a new seed. Full list: [player guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md) and the PR below.
## Install
1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher. 2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder. 3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.
### Visual Tracker
`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:
1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher. 2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it. 3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.
Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!
Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).
